meta.title: Light & Darkness
meta.subtitle: Cross-System Spell Reference
meta.description: Every low-level illumination, concealment, and dazzling effect pulled from AD&D 2e, Pathfinder 1e & 2e, D&D 5e, and GURPS 4e — set side by side for comparison.

items.name: Dancing Lights
items.effect: Creates 1–4 lights resembling torches/lanterns, glowing spheres, or one faint man-shaped glow. Moves at the caster’s will without concentration, up to 100’/round.
items.notes: Winks out if range is exceeded. Cannot be used to blind (see Light).

items.name: Light
items.effect: Torchlight-equivalent glow within 20’ of a chosen point. Cast on a creature’s eyes, it blinds (−4 attack/save, −4 AC).
items.notes: Reversible to Darkness at half duration. Not cumulative — multiple castings don’t add brightness.

items.name: Dancing Lights
items.effect: Up to four lights as torches, will-o-wisp orbs, or one faint humanoid shape. Move as desired, no concentration required.
items.notes: Only one casting active at a time; recasting dispels the prior one.

items.name: Light
items.area: 20-ft radius, +20 ft at one step dimmer
items.effect: Touched object glows like a torch, raising the light level by one step for an extra 20 ft.
items.notes: Counters/dispels equal-or-lower-level Darkness. Only one active at a time.

items.name: Faerie Fire
items.effect: Outlines subjects in pale candlelight glow. –20 Stealth penalty; targets lose concealment from darkness, blur, displacement, or invisibility.
items.notes: Color chosen by caster (blue, green, violet). Reveals figment illusions of equal or lower CL.

items.name: Flare
items.effect: Burst of light; target is dazzled for 1 minute unless it succeeds on a Fortitude save.
items.notes: No effect on sightless or already-dazzled creatures.

items.name: Penumbra
items.effect: Keeps the target slightly shadowed, negating penalties or blindness from bright light (light sensitivity, light blindness).
items.notes: Will negates (harmless, usually waived). Only one active at a time. Superseded at higher level by Protective Penumbra.

items.name: Dancing Lights
items.area: Lights stay within 20 ft of each other
items.effect: Up to four torch-sized lights, or combined into one Medium humanoid glow. Each sheds dim light in a 10-ft radius. Move 60 ft as a bonus action.
items.notes: Material: phosphorus, wychwood, or a glowworm.

items.name: Light
items.targets: One object ≤ 10 ft in any dimension
items.effect: Object sheds bright light 20 ft and dim light another 20 ft, in a color of the caster’s choice.
items.notes: Targeting an unwilling creature’s gear allows a save. Ends if recast or dismissed.

items.name: Faerie Fire
items.effect: Outlines objects and any creature failing a Dex save; outlined creatures/objects shed dim light 10 ft and can’t benefit from invisibility.
items.notes: Color chosen by caster (blue, green, violet).

items.name: Dancing Lights
items.area: Lights stay within 10 ft of each other
items.effect: Up to four floating lights, each shedding light like a torch. Sustain to move any number of lights up to 60 ft.
items.notes: Winks out if a light exceeds 120 ft of caster or 10 ft of the other lights.

items.name: Light
items.targets: 1 unattended, non-magical object (1 Bulk or less)
items.effect: Object glows, casting bright light 20 ft and dim light another 20 ft, like a torch.
items.higher: Heightened (4th): radius doubles to 60 ft bright / 60 ft dim.
items.notes: Recasting on a second object ends the spell on the first.

items.name: Faerie Fire
items.effect: Creatures are limned in colorful, heatless fire. Visible creatures can’t be concealed; invisible creatures become merely concealed rather than undetected.
items.notes: Color chosen by caster.

items.name: Light
items.effect: Soft glow at base cost; 2 pts gives campfire-equivalent light; 3 pts gives light bright enough to be painful at close range (~100W bulb).
items.higher: Cost scales the brightness directly: 1 / 2 / 3 points.
items.notes: Cost: 1 to cast, 1 to maintain. A 3-point casting cancels an equal area of Darkness. Root of the entire college.

items.name: Darkness
items.effect: Blots out light within its area of effect.
items.notes: Permanently dispels Light if cast over a lit area; temporarily dispels Continual Light. Cancels a Flash spell’s effect (but not vice versa). Root of the Darkness branch.

items.name: Continual Light
items.effect: As Light, but self-sustaining — no active maintenance needed for its duration.
items.higher: Brightness scales the same as Light: 1 / 2 / 3 points.
items.notes: Maintainable at half original cost. Item enchant cost: 20× base in a high-mana game (100× standard). Gateway to Beacon, Faerie Fire, Light Amplification, Dancing Lights (permanent).

items.name: Colors
items.effect: Grants control over hue rather than brightness alone.
items.notes: Low prerequisite branching to Mirror, Hue, Kaleidoscope, Chameleon, Glitterdust.

items.name: Mage Light
items.effect: As Light, but visible only to the caster (and anyone else specified, e.g. fellow mages).
items.notes: Useful for covert illumination invisible to mundane observers.

items.name: Light Jet
items.level: Regular — Prereq: Continual Light or Shape Light
items.effect: A narrow stream of light. Half cost: low-power 5-yard reading-light beam. Double cost: intense 80-yard beam that can blind.
items.higher: Cost doubling extends range and blinding capability.
items.notes: Targeted with DX or Magic Jet (Light Jet) skill.

items.name: Flash
items.effect: Blinding burst of light. Creatures in the area must resist or be Dazzled.
items.notes: Gateway prerequisite to Dazzle, Flare, Flashcone, Strobe, Optical Stun.

items.name: Dancing Lights
items.level: Regular — Prereq: Light, Simple Illusion, or Dancing Flames
items.effect: 1–4 mobile lights: torches, lanterns, glowing orbs, or a faint humanoid figure. Moves at the caster’s will, no concentration needed.
items.higher: Doubling cost doubles either the range from caster or the number of lights.
items.notes: Cost: 2 to cast, 1 to maintain. Vanishes if it strays more than 25 hexes from the caster.

items.name: Faerie Fire
items.level: Regular, resisted by HT — Prereq: Continual Light
items.effect: Bright halo around the subject; removes darkness-based concealment bonuses and outlines invisible creatures. Not bright enough to serve as a real light source.
items.notes: Cost: 3 to cast, 2 to maintain. In bright light, gives no benefit except outlining invisible foes.

items.name: Glow
items.effect: Minimal “make this luminous” utility effect, castable directly on a person or object.
items.notes: From GURPS Grimoire, not the core Magic book.
